title: Early head movement
description: Head rotation or translation begins before the contact-stability window ends.

title: Reversed proximal-to-distal sequence
description: Distal segment or racket acceleration begins before adequate lower-body or trunk contribution.

title: Insufficient lower-body contribution
description: Little load, COM displacement, or leg extension occurs where context supports it.

title: Contact spacing outside envelope
description: Ball-body relationship falls outside personalized context-specific range.

title: Late contact
description: Contact occurs behind a personalized context-specific envelope.

title: Blocked follow-through
description: Post-contact path terminates or collapses outside an appropriate family range.

title: Balance loss
description: Estimated COM exits base of support without controlled recovery.

title: Delayed recovery
description: First purposeful return to readiness is delayed for shot context.

title: Suspected grip mismatch
description: Visible hand-racket geometry appears inconsistent with the stroke family. This remains inferential unless clearly visible.

title: Insufficient visual evidence
description: Camera angle, blur, crop, or occlusion prevents reliable assessment. Never penalize technique.
